A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Simple by design.
Clear from the start.

A shared care workspace for barangay health workers, midwives, mothers and guardians, built by Group 03.

Who is E-Nay for?

Health workers and midwives manage clinical records and vaccine inventory. Mothers and guardians use patient accounts to view only the care profiles linked by the clinic.

Can I really use it without internet?

Sign in while connected first, then wait for “Offline ready” and confirmation of an encrypted device copy. Unlock that copy with your password when offline. A new device needs internet for its first sign-in. External reading links need a connection.

Do my phone and computer share records?

Yes. Sign in online on each device to load the latest clinic records permitted for your account. Staff edits saved offline sync when connected. Conflicting changes require staff review, so one device cannot silently overwrite another.

What happens to my existing Java project?

The Java console and desktop apps remain available. Import and export their maternal and child text files from Data & backup. Visits, growth, inventory, and other browser-only fields are included in the complete web backup, not in the Java profile files.
